raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver step derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), but the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor expects txn_date to match the date of txn_ts. Every POSTED row has ingest_ts on the following day at 02:00, so all 4558 POSTED rows mismatch, and the 2026-01-16 refactor (DE-398) appears to have introduced the ingest-based derivation. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the monitored invariant, and the gold tables recompute from the corrected silver table.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.6,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
